findings.root_cause: Commit 4218e829de3e47ef3e8965eae9df16b51c61d79f made ffmpeg a mandatory assertion inside the live visual evidence module, but the pinned ubuntu-24.04 GitHub-hosted runner did not provide ffmpeg. The authenticated health, authorization, tenant-isolation, kiosk and attendance-correction proofs completed successfully before the visual module failed, so this is a proof-harness/toolchain dependency regression rather than a WFM product defect.

evidence.failure: AssertionError: ffmpeg is unavailable on the pinned runner; cannot create the browser recording.

findings.root_cause: The current main workflow executes the secret-bearing browser proof without the Chrome >=153.0.8010.47 preflight that exists only on open draft PR 38. Recent hosted-staging HTTP evidence identifies HeadlessChrome/152.0.0.0 during authenticated browser proof activity. No compromise is observed; the risk is that a credential-bearing browser automation path is allowed to run below the already-validated patched-browser floor.
findings.containment_state: Do not weaken the Chrome floor from PR 38. Rebase/reconcile that fail-closed preflight with current main before treating browser visual proof as security-cleared.

machine_readable_detection_rules.required_external_encoder_policy: If browser video is mandatory, the encoder must be integrity-pinned and verified before WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD is loaded. If no approved encoder exists, fail before secret retrieval rather than after authenticated proof execution.
machine_readable_detection_rules.classification_rule: A visual-artifact encoder failure after independent auth/isolation/correction proof success is a proof-harness failure and must not be reported as a WFM runtime failure.

safe_runbook: Preserve the sealed 0.6.76 runtime and current Railway staging deployment; do not redeploy or mutate production to address this incident.
Before the workflow reads Railway variables containing WFM_STAGING_PASSWORD, preflight the browser security floor and every mandatory external evidence binary.
For ffmpeg, either remove the hard dependency from the credential-bearing proof path or introduce an integrity-verified pinned encoder artifact; do not rely on ambient runner packages.
Rebase the Chrome security-floor control from PR 38 onto the current main lineage and rerun the exact candidate security and staging proof gates.
Only merge workflow/proof-wrapper changes when the branch is current with main and the exact candidate gates pass; do not merge application-runtime changes as part of this incident.

collision_avoidance.reason: scripts/live-visual-evidence.mjs was modified on main immediately before detection, indicating an active source owner. This incident branch intentionally does not edit that script or the deployment workflow.

learning: Credential-bearing proof automation must preflight both security floors and evidence-tool dependencies before secrets are materialized. Optional evidence enhancements must never obscure the distinction between a healthy staging runtime and a broken proof harness.
claim_boundary: This incident concerns fixture-only hosted staging and CI/proof controls. It does not assert production exposure, compromise, tenant leakage, payroll mutation or customer-data impact.
